messages.content: What is the common ancestor of lion and zebra?

function.name: calculate_fibonacci_sequence

message.content: The last common ancestor of the clade that includes the families **Felidae** (cats) and **Equidae** (horses). In other words, it is the last common ancestor of the two orders **Carnivora** (which contains lions) and **Perissodactyla** (which contains zebras). This ancestor was a small, early placental mammal that lived roughly 70 million years ago, long before either lions or zebras evolved.
